name: Easy Strider Living
summary: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong offers to share her strider stew recipe with hunters who bring her foreststrider meat.

sections.title: A Taste of the Wild
sections.body: Auberdine's coastal folk make use of the wildlife around them. Alanndarian Nightsong has her own recipe for hearty strider stew, made from the tall foreststriders that roam Darkshore's woods. She asks you to hunt the birds and bring back their meat before she shares her cooking.

sections.title: Hunting the Foreststriders
sections.body: Foreststriders range through the woodlands and beaches north and south of Auberdine. Their sharp beaks and quick tempers make them dangerous when provoked, but their meat makes a rich stew. Bring fresh meat to Alanndarian, and she will share her recipe.

faq.answer: Alanndarian Nightsong lives in Auberdine, in Darkshore. She offers to teach her strider stew recipe to travelers who prove their hunting skill.

faq.q: Where do I find the strider meat?
faq.answer: Hunt foreststriders across Darkshore for their meat. The large, flightless birds roam the shorelines and wooded groves outside Auberdine.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: You hunt foreststriders and bring five cuts of meat to Alanndarian Nightsong. In return, she teaches you to prepare Strider Stew.

faq.q: Are the foreststriders dangerous to hunt?
faq.answer: Foreststriders have sharp beaks and quick legs, and they grow aggressive when approached. Hunt with care.

faq.q: Does this quest unlock a cooking recipe?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring Alanndarian the meat she asks for, and she teaches you the recipe for Strider Stew.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You begin and end in Auberdine, and hunt in the wilderness of Darkshore.

angles.text: As a cook traveling through Darkshore, you can learn to prepare Strider Stew from local wildlife.
As a night elf in Kalimdor, you know the value of living off the land. Strider stew is a coastal staple in Auberdine.
As a hunter, you can practice tracking and hunting swift foreststriders along Darkshore's misty paths.
